noops.message: No action taken on issue #351: the rich-triage scripts were denied, so the completeness, FAQ, duplicate, named-API checks and label/comment validation could not run, and the skill requires validation before any label or comment. Manual review: the issue is a runnable example with an output-based question ("Am I doing it wrong?") about no_wrap/overflow column behaviour, which may be a usage question or a squashed-columns bug; a maintainer should decide. Possibly related earlier issue to check: #2890 (no_wrap squashing columns), not confirmed as a duplicate.
